description: Private read-only signed request. Purpose-derived HMAC key from existing HERTA_MBTI_SYNC_SECRET. Only configured DISCORD_GUILD_ID and active members with approved profiles. No browser CORS, no-store on every response. No public birthday view changes.

hertaFortuneHmac.name: X-IVRM-Signature
hertaFortuneHmac.description: See operation x-ivrm-hmac for key derivation, canonical text and other signed headers.

headers.name: X-IVRM-Timestamp
headers.description: Exact UTC ISO toISOString timestamp with milliseconds; max skew given by x-ivrm-hmac.maxTimestampSkewMs.

headers.name: X-IVRM-Event-Id
headers.description: UUID exactly equal to body.requestId; bound into canonical signed text.

headers.name: X-IVRM-Signature
headers.description: Purpose-derived HMAC-SHA256 over x-ivrm-hmac.canonical. Derive raw key first per x-ivrm-hmac. Lowercase hex only.

hmac.replay: read-only; no side effects within timestamp window

requestId.description: MUST exactly equal X-IVRM-Event-Id and be bound into the canonical signature.

guildId.description: MUST equal Discord interaction.guildId and the explicitly configured allowed guild. Consumer MUST reject other guilds before sending any user ID; Producer MUST check DISCORD_GUILD_ID.

discordUserId.description: MUST equal Discord interaction.user.id, the executor of this invocation. Never accept a user-supplied target ID or arbitrary member lookup. HMAC authenticates the service, so Consumer MUST enforce this subject binding.
Echo of the authenticated request subject; Consumer MUST compare to interaction.user.id before use.

birthday.description: Approved full date of birth, 1900 or later, not future; server-only, never publish.

bloodType.description: Currently null: ivrm-web has no persisted blood-type field. Never infer.
